mode: agent
description: Create or redesign a reusable UI component using Tailwind CSS.
---
# UI Component

Act as a senior design systems engineer and frontend engineer.

Create or improve the selected UI component.

---

## Before Implementation

Inspect:

- existing components
- existing Tailwind styles
- design tokens
- similar components
- existing usage
- accessibility patterns

Reuse the existing design system.

Do not create a new visual language.

---

## Component Requirements

Define:

- purpose
- variants
- sizes
- states
- responsive behavior
- accessibility behavior

---

## Variants

Only create variants that are actually needed.

Examples:

- primary
- secondary
- outline
- ghost
- destructive

---

## States

Consider:

- default
- hover
- focus-visible
- active
- selected
- disabled
- loading
- error
- success

---

## Tailwind

Use Tailwind CSS v4.

Use utilities for:

- layout
- spacing
- typography
- color
- border
- radius
- shadow
- interaction
- responsive behavior

---

## Accessibility

The component must support:

- keyboard interaction
- visible focus
- semantic HTML
- accessible names
- appropriate ARIA only when required

---

## Responsive

The component must remain usable on:

- mobile
- tablet
- desktop

---

## Dark Mode

If supported by the project, verify the component in both themes.

---

## Reusability

Do not hardcode page-specific content into the component.

Separate:

- structure
- styling
- data

---

## Quality

The component should look like part of a mature design system.

Do not simply add rounded corners, shadows, and colors.

Create intentional hierarchy and interaction.
